title: Space Shooter - Defend the Galaxy

texts.text:
CONTROLS:
WASD / Arrow Keys - Move
SPACE - Shoot
ESC - Pause

OBJECTIVE:
Destroy enemies and survive waves
Collect power-ups for upgrades
Achieve the highest score!

INSTRUCTIONS:

Use WASD or Arrow Keys to move your ship
Hold SPACE to shoot at enemies
Collect green power-ups for health
Collect purple power-ups for weapon upgrades
Survive as long as possible!

Press any key to return to menu
